Hello, everyone. I have an update today on the next update for the game. It will Launch on December 6th, 2024, bringing with it Four New levels, New Achievements, New QoL Features, Revised Levels, and more.

The big update is the four new levels. These will be larger-than-normal maps with more exploration opportunities than the previous levels. With these new maps, the game's file size will be around 5-6GB. This is about a 3GB update or so compared to the base game. Since the update is so close to Christmas, I will be including the Christmas update with Update 2.0.

[b]New Features[/b]
Level 27-30(Normal Mode & Permadeath Mode)
New Achievements
Revised Snow Levels(15-19) To Be More In Line With Level 20
New Foliage Types For Certain Levels
New Textures For Certain Levels

And more to discover for yourselves!

[b]Changes & Fixes[/b]
Fixed the Subtitles staying on screen for longer than necessary and changed the font to something more in line with other games. 

Changed the way the Level Selection UI works. It will now be all on one page and be easier to choose which level you want to play.

Fixed issues with bush SFX sound cues randomly playing on Level 21 when you haven't walked through a bush. 

Changed lighting of several levels to be more cinematic and pretty.

Tesha the main character will now have a new hair colour.


While I still have stuff to share, I will let you all figure that out for yourselves.

I truly hope everyone has a great rest of the year and I hope to continue making games I am proud of for many years to come. 


Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Rent's Due: The Game Major Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I have some exciting things to announce today relating to Rent's Due: The Game. Hopefully, this update will help bring some new players to the game and bring returning players back to play the new content. Let's get into it.


[b]New Levels[/b]

Rent's Due: The Game is finally getting new levels, four new levels to be exact, bringing the level count to a solid 30! So far these levels are shaping out well, Level 27 is inspired by the planet Mars, with my own unique twist for level design purposes. Level 27 brings with it some nice small details. One is interactive foliage that reacts to Tesha to name one. 

Level 28 is inspired by the planet Venus. This is a unique terrain as well, bringing with it interactive snow trails since it will be a snow-populated planet. 

These new levels will offer unique terrains that are being created using real heightmap data, this allows me to create landscapes and make them very unique compared to designing every landscape just from my imagination. 



[b]Small Changes[/b]

Now some levels that used weather ended up being very loud, level 25 is a good example of this thanks to the thunder and lightning. Well the volume of the weather effects going forward have been reduced from 100% to 20%. Hopefully this will be a welcome change.

I have also updated several particle systems including money pickups, blocks that disappear and more. The money pickup had a really aggressive white flash before the paper ripping particle effect would play, I am happy to say that the white flash has been removed from this and other particle systems that were affected. 

Now for the blocks that like to break and pop out of existence when Tesha steps on them, they have received a new particle effect depending on what block type it is. This basically means that the ice blocks would look different to a metal block when breaking.

Other small changes are not final yet but I will keep everyone informed in the patch notes for the update.



Now when will this update release? Well I don't have an exact date as I am working on this solo but It will be near the end of November if everything goes to plan.

notes.title: Rent’s Due: The Game - The Definitive Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We have a surprise update dropping for Rent’s Due:The Game soon. This update will be called the definitive update. This update will give the game a fresh coat of paint, more detail and an improved User Interface. 

This update will include a new main menu, new ways to choose which level you want to play and potentially a few new language options however that isn’t confirmed. 

Several levels will be getting completely new looks in terms of overall atmosphere and background level design. For example, level 20 has now been changed from a completely frozen level to one that is now made up by a beautiful ocean, with icebergs floating around. You may even see a boat pass by. 

The update will update several levels with new lighting and added detail, like improved foliage, improved draw distance and more. 

As this update is focused on increasing graphic fidelity, this comes with a performance cost so the system requirements will be raised before the update drops. It shouldn’t be drastic but it will be raised to what we think is best for performance. 

This update will release before Christmas, but we don’t have a solid date. 

Fall Into Insanity, our other game in active development will have more updates next year. 



Thank you for all of the amazing support, we look forward to delivering the Definitive Update for Rent’s Due:The Game

notes.title: Introducing Troll Mode, Coming In The Last Rent's Due: The Game Update.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, a very short update today to talk about the new mode coming to Rent's Due: The Game in the last update for the game!


The new Mode is called Troll Mode!

In this mode its the core gameplay loop of Rent's Due: The Game. However, things are a lot different at the same time. For example, if you run into some cash it might explode and respawn you?  This mode is all about tricking the player and making them laugh a little bit. This mode will not feature every single level as I feel like it could get very repetitive so you will play a total of 6 levels in troll mode. These levels are Level 1, 2, 3, 8, 21 & 26.  

Along with this update the game will be getting 2 new achievements relating to the new mode,. The First will be for just playing Troll Mode. The last will be for beating troll mode! 

If troll mode does well and the players like it then I might add to it in the future whenever I can. 

One last piece of information you guys should know is that Rent's Due: The Game recently moved to Unreal Engine 5. In the new update for the game You will see better shadows, thanks to Nanite I have managed to apply new materials to some foliage in levels, including new tree textures on Level 21, as well as a new platform material on said level. 

Also coming is better lighting thanks to lumen, I have tried to optimise this as much as possible but it does come with a slight performance increase on levels that use the new lumen lighting. Levels that don't take advantage of Lumen will use Screen Space Global Illumination instead.

Lastly since Rent's Due has moved to a whole new engine, there may be some bugs and other problems that have slipped through the cracks, If you happen to encounter any issues then please post in the community forums or send an email to help.scottygames@gmail.com.


I look forward to releasing this final update for the game, I hope everyone has a nice week, see you all on August 26th for the One Year Anniversary!

notes.title: Rent's Due: The Game 1 Year Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you are all doing well! 

Rent's Due: The Game is turning 1 soon and honestly for my first game it has been a long and hard road but we got here in the end. To mark the special occasion, Rent's Due: The Game will be getting a new update which will also be it's last. 

This update will mostly be bug fixes but it may contain a few surprises. Maybe a new mode???

Anyway I apologise for the very vague update, it's very sad to me that this will be the games last update but I have already started working on a couple new projects and I think its time I speak a little bit about them. 


Project 1997: This is the name I have been using throughout the early development stages, its not the official title but you will know what that is soon enough. Anyway what is this game? Well Project 1997 is a multiplayer horror game built using Unreal Engine 5. The game is very early in development but I will hopefully have some more stuff to reveal in the coming months!


ProjectSurvivalMP: This one is fairly obvious but this project will be a survival multiplayer game taking place in a vast open world using world engine along with Unreal Engine 5! This project actually has a small group of people working on it compared to just the two that worked on Rent's Due. This game will feature 6 player coop (If all goes to plan) in a story of trying to survive in a beautiful yet deadly world brought to life by world engine and Unreal Engine 5. 


These projects are very early in development but if you want to keep up with the latest news and devlogs on these projects then please keep an eye out on future announcements on the Rent's Due page as we will soon be releasing our website! 


Thank you all so much for the support over the last year, hopefully we can create more great games in the future!

notes.title: Rent's Due: The Game version 1.1 will be releasing in May
notes.notes:
Hello everyone I wanted to post a short update detailing the new content dropping for Rent's Due: The Game on May 20th, 2022. 

The game will be receiving 3 new levels, I am happy to detail what they will be like right now.
[list]
[*] [b]Level 24[/b]: Level 24 will be a level similar to how Level 1-5 are designed however instead of water you will now have to deal with acid along with new traps and new mechanics to help you get through levels in new ways. 
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Level 25[/b]: Level 25 is something very new while it has the core Rent's Due: The Game mechanics, Level 25 will offer a dark and gritty map with AI roaming around the map however it will be hard to see them as this map takes advantage of fog and thunder and lightning. The map will be similar to how Level 23 was designed with a strong focus on landscape design and detail. 
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Level 26[/b]: Level 26 will be very colourful and vibrant compared to Level 25. Level 26 is very unique as it is completely made out of delicious candy or sweets if you are not in the states. This level will feature pink Volumetric Clouds, Brand New Assets and new traps. Level 26 is my favourite as it is such a shift from levels I have made previously and I really cant wait to show it off once Version 1.1 release on May 20th. 
[/list]


Rent's Due: The Game will also be receiving some quality of life updates as well. I want to start this off with addressing the GPU issue where when you play Rent's Due it can sometimes get really high in the GPU Usage department. So to combat this from Version 1.1 onwards you will now be able to limit the frame rate to reduce the GPU usage and to reduce screen tear on screens that have a refresh rate of 60 or below. This update will add the ability to run the game at 30FPS, 60 FPS, 74 FPS, 90 FPS, 120 FPS, 144FPS and finally you can choose to run the game on unlimited which is by default. Remember if you have a monitor that has a low refresh rate then please choose the setting in the main menu or pause menu while in game. 


See you on May 20th.

notes.title: PATCH 1.04 is Here and Not Delayed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, first of let me start by addressing the previous announcement I made about patch 1.04. I said it would be delayed and would not be released by Friday, September 24th. Well turns out I was wrong, the crash I was dealing with has now been fixed and we can move forward with the update! 

So what's new? 

[b]Improved Weather System For Certain Levels[/b]

While developing this update, I had implemented a new weather system plugin into the engine, this made the game look and sound a lot better but sadly that plugin was the reason behind the game-breaking crash.

I had to remove it and rebuild the weather myself and I am very happy with how it looks now, you will notice that snow levels have much better lighting and overall better graphics! 

[b]New Traps[/b]

This one is pretty small but you will notice some new traps in the game as well as other things that can help you reach areas to get more money.


[b]New Checkpoint Design[/b]

This one is another small change but the new checkpoint design suits the game a lot more than the previous one. 


[b]Changed UI Effects[/b]

After receiving feedback about how annoying the clicking sound for the menus was, I changed the sound effect to hopefully something less annoying. 


[b]Minor Changes[/b]

Removed Music from Level 1-5 due to players receiving copy strikes on steams or videos. Level 1-5 now has the same music as Level 11-15 until I implement the new music system coming soon.


This update has been the biggest for the game yet but there is more to come, today I am happy to share the first screenshot of the first set of levels I am working on which should be dropping by the end of November along with a new mode, the Time Trial mode.

Remember the screenshot I am about to share is very early in development, the base map is finished but the atmosphere and other areas are not complete yet.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/372167367024967681/890779638077472768/TMTease.png[/img]


Thank you everyone fall all the support, it is really appreciated!

notes.title: Update Coming Soon Adding New Systems, Some Small Changes and Improvements.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I know I have been relatively silent on new content coming to the game but I assure it I am working on it slowly as I come up with new level designs and mechanics. Since launch, I have been working on fixing bugs and a couple of nagging issues, and these should all be addressed in the next update. 

What is in this update you ask? Well, let me tell you. 


[b]New Weather System[/b]

Yes, this was a big one to get implemented.  The New Weather System adds new sound effects and of course new weather to the game on certain levels that require rain or snow. For example, the snow levels will now have a better snow particle system as well as nice ambient sounds to go along with it. 

The Rain weather system has also been overhauled, Not only will you get a nice thunder ambiance sound but you will get improved rain particles that bounce off objects in the world as well, adding a small but very nice detail. 


[b]Snow Levels Have Improved Lighting[/b]

As the header suggests, the snow levels have been improved with better lighting and you should post a very big difference.  Here are comparison images of before and after. 

[b]BEFORE[/b]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/372167367024967681/887228485410639882/unknown.png?width=1203&height=676[/img]

[b]AFTER[/b]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/372167367024967681/887235722539573278/unknown.png[/img]


You can see in the second screenshot that the lighting seems a lot brighter as well as some fog effects. This is thanks to the new snow system that you will see when you play the levels. 


[b]New Checkpoint Design[/b]

The game will now have a new checkpoint design going forward. This was done to avoid any confusion when seeing the old red sprite on a darker level. 



This update will fix several issues that have been brought to my attention. These include,

[list]
[*] Vastly Improved Performance. To achieve this, I removed all Planar Reflections and replaced them with Screen Space Reflections, you should see a good boost in performance.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Unresponsive Checkpoints should now be ironed out completely unless I have missed one or two.
[/list]



This update will bring a few other things but I am keeping them a secret for now. As always thank you to everyone who has played the game and left a review, it really means a lot to me and since I am still learning to be a game dev, I will take all the feedback I can get!

This update should drop by Friday, September 24th, but no promises, it could come earlier or later I am still not sure.
